ownerRuling: the underlying concepts are good, but the rewrite got too clever i had to think too hard and i missed the point

jupiter-aries.before: The first move produced evidence that more waiting could not supply.
jupiter-aries.after: After you replied, you got the rate and a scheduled call.
jupiter-aries.plainMeaning: Replying produced two concrete answers that waiting had not produced.

jupiter-aries.before: The useful impulse goes wrong when the first yes becomes the pattern for every later demand, even as the terms grow beyond what you first accepted.
jupiter-aries.after: The first quick yes becomes the answer to every later request.
jupiter-aries.plainMeaning: One quick acceptance becomes the expectation for later requests.

jupiter-aries.before: You have the opportunity, and it takes more time than the first reply accounted for.
jupiter-aries.after: The offer is real, and the hours no longer fit the calendar.
jupiter-aries.plainMeaning: The offer exists, but its hours exceed the available calendar.

uranus-taurus.before: Keeping the familiar numbers now produces the insecurity those numbers were supposed to prevent.
uranus-taurus.after: The old budget no longer covers both the grocery order and the fixed payment.
uranus-taurus.plainMeaning: The old budget cannot cover the two ordinary costs shown in the scene.

uranus-taurus.before: Changing the setup is the useful impulse, because waiting for complete certainty lets the mismatch grow.
uranus-taurus.after: Changing the budget before the shortfall grows is necessary.
uranus-taurus.plainMeaning: The budget must change before the missing amount increases.

uranus-taurus.before: Security now rests on what the current numbers can support.
uranus-taurus.after: The new budget has to cover today's bill and next week's payment.
uranus-taurus.plainMeaning: The replacement budget must cover the bills that actually exist now.

pluto-capricorn.before: Power stays concentrated when rank determines both the decision and whose evidence can reverse it.
pluto-capricorn.after: The same leaders make the decision and decide which records matter.
pluto-capricorn.plainMeaning: The leaders control both the decision and the records considered in reviewing it.

pluto-capricorn.before: Your objection becomes part of the file, but the leaders who approved the targets still decide what counts as proof.
pluto-capricorn.after: The complaint is filed; the leaders who set the targets reject the schedules.
pluto-capricorn.plainMeaning: The complaint is recorded, but the target-setters reject the submitted schedules.

pluto-capricorn.before: The useful Capricorn impulse is to preserve continuity through clear standards and accountable leadership.
pluto-capricorn.after: Capricorn's standards are meant to keep the institution running and its leaders accountable.
pluto-capricorn.plainMeaning: The standards should preserve the institution while keeping its leaders answerable.
